profile.headline: Experienced Software Engineer
profile.summary:
Electrical and computer engineering professional with over 18 years of experience and a MS in Computer Engineering.  Rapid learner who excels at teaching and training others.  Solid programming experience in C, NI TestStand, NI LabWindows/CVI, and Visual Basic.

Programming languages: C, C++, Java, Visual Basic, NI TestStand, NI LabWindows/CVI, NI LabVIEW, HTML, SQL 
Fluent in English and Spanish

positions.title: Full Stack Developer
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas, United States · Remote

positions.title: Software Engineer III
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
Mentor new engineers on the company processes and procedures and how to develop their legacy TPS rehosting projects.
Assist other engineers with their projects and questions on a need basis.
Continue to perform the responsibilities of a Software Engineer II.
Product owner for ATE responsible for all aspects of production cycle including research and development, build, documentation, customer delivery, and post-delivery support of more than $4.5M.
positions.insights: C (Programming Language), Software Development and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.locationName: San Antonio, Texas Metropolitan Area · On-site
positions.description:
Gather requirements, design, develop, troubleshoot, and analyze software programs and hardware for computer based automated testing systems of LRU and SRU for the USAF.
Perform software system testing procedures; programming, integration, delivery and documentation.
Was part of a team, responsible for upgrading legacy polyglot code to Java and C++, which tasks included; developing and reviewing code, performance benchmarking, researching improvements, and adding functionality using Agile development.
.
positions.insights: NI TestStand, NI LabVIEW and +3 skills

positions.title: Software Project Engineer II
positions.description:
Develop custom software for functional test systems including GUI, control panel, and device driver development to operate; oscilloscopes, power supplies, DMMs, logic analyzers, microcontrollers, and other testing equipment through 1553, TCP/IP, GPIB, PXI, USB, and VXI.
Interface, troubleshoot, and debug software applications to hardware.
Interact with remote DoD contractors to develop complex projects.

positions.title: Technical Support Group Member
positions.description:
Resolve customer problems with their website, email, software, etc.
Provide basic maintenance to Apache servers.
Promote the company's services over the telephone or email.

positions.title: Graduate Reasearch Assistant
positions.description:
Redesigned, maintained, and updated the Graduate School’s webpage.
Provided design ideas for the Graduate School’s webpage.
Helped produce posters and brochures for the Graduate School Office.
